text: Men loving according to their own will and fearing according to that of the prince, a wise prince should establish himself on that which is in his own control and not in that of others; he must endeavour only to avoid hatred.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XVII, Concerning cruelty and clemency, and whether it is better to be loved than feared
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
